verses.ar: وَقَالَ ٱلرَّبُّ لِنُوحٍ: «ٱدْخُلْ أَنْتَ وَجَمِيعُ بَيْتِكَ إِلَى ٱلْفُلْكِ، لِأَنِّي إِيَّاكَ رَأَيْتُ بَارًّا لَدَيَّ فِي هَذَا ٱلْجِيلِ.
verses.kjv: And the LORD said unto Noah, Come thou and all thy house into the ark; for thee have I seen righteous before me in this generation.
verses.web: Yahweh said to Noah, “Come with all of your household into the ship, for I have seen your righteousness before me in this generation.

verses.ar: مِنْ جَمِيعِ ٱلْبَهَائِمِ ٱلطَّاهِرَةِ تَأْخُذُ مَعَكَ سَبْعَةً سَبْعَةً ذَكَرًا وَأُنْثَى. وَمِنَ ٱلْبَهَائِمِ ٱلَّتِي لَيْسَتْ بِطَاهِرَةٍ ٱثْنَيْنِ: ذَكَرًا وَأُنْثَى.
verses.kjv: Of every clean beast thou shalt take to thee by sevens, the male and his female: and of beasts that [are] not clean by two, the male and his female.
verses.web: You shall take seven pairs of every clean animal with you, the male and his female. Of the animals that are not clean, take two, the male and his female.

verses.ar: وَمِنْ طُيُورِ ٱلسَّمَاءِ أَيْضًا سَبْعَةً سَبْعَةً: ذَكَرًا وَأُنْثَى. لِٱسْتِبْقَاءِ نَسْلٍ عَلَى وَجْهِ كُلِّ ٱلْأَرْضِ.
verses.kjv: Of fowls also of the air by sevens, the male and the female; to keep seed alive upon the face of all the earth.
verses.web: Also of the birds of the sky, seven and seven, male and female, to keep seed alive on the surface of all the earth.

verses.ar: لِأَنِّي بَعْدَ سَبْعَةِ أَيَّامٍ أَيْضًا أُمْطِرُ عَلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ أَرْبَعِينَ يَوْمًا وَأَرْبَعِينَ لَيْلَةً. وَأَمْحُو عَنْ وَجْهِ ٱلْأَرْضِ كُلَّ قَائِمٍ عَمِلْتُهُ».
verses.kjv: For yet seven days, and I will cause it to rain upon the earth forty days and forty nights; and every living substance that I have made will I destroy from off the face of the earth.
verses.web: In seven days, I will cause it to rain on the earth for forty days and forty nights. I will destroy every living thing that I have made from the surface of the ground.”

verses.ar: فَفَعَلَ نُوحٌ حَسَبَ كُلِّ مَا أَمَرَهُ بِهِ ٱلرَّبُّ.
verses.kjv: And Noah did according unto all that the LORD commanded him.
verses.web: Noah did everything that Yahweh commanded him.

verses.ar: وَلَمَّا كَانَ نُوحٌ ٱبْنَ سِتِّ مِئَةِ سَنَةٍ صَارَ طُوفَانُ ٱلْمَاءِ عَلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ،
verses.kjv: And Noah [was] six hundred years old when the flood of waters was upon the earth.
verses.web: Noah was six hundred years old when the flood of waters came on the earth.

verses.ar: فَدَخَلَ نُوحٌ وَبَنُوهُ وَٱمْرَأَتُهُ وَنِسَاءُ بَنِيهِ مَعَهُ إِلَى ٱلْفُلْكِ مِنْ وَجْهِ مِيَاهِ ٱلطُّوفَانِ.
verses.kjv: ¶ And Noah went in, and his sons, and his wife, and his sons’ wives with him, into the ark, because of the waters of the flood.
verses.web: Noah went into the ship with his sons, his wife, and his sons’ wives, because of the floodwaters.

verses.ar: وَمِنَ ٱلْبَهَائِمِ ٱلطَّاهِرَةِ وَٱلْبَهَائِمِ ٱلَّتِي لَيْسَتْ بِطَاهِرَةٍ، وَمِنَ ٱلطُّيُورِ وَكُلِّ مَا يَدِبُّ عَلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ:
verses.kjv: Of clean beasts, and of beasts that [are] not clean, and of fowls, and of every thing that creepeth upon the earth,
verses.web: Clean animals, unclean animals, birds, and everything that creeps on the ground

verses.ar: دَخَلَ ٱثْنَانِ ٱثْنَانِ إِلَى نُوحٍ إِلَى ٱلْفُلْكِ، ذَكَرًا وَأُنْثَى، كَمَا أَمَرَ ٱللهُ نُوحًا.
verses.kjv: There went in two and two unto Noah into the ark, the male and the female, as God had commanded Noah.
verses.web: went by pairs to Noah into the ship, male and female, as God commanded Noah.

verses.ar: وَحَدَثَ بَعْدَ ٱلسَّبْعَةِ ٱلْأَيَّامِ أَنَّ مِيَاهَ ٱلطُّوفَانِ صَارَتْ عَلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ.
verses.kjv: And it came to pass after seven days, that the waters of the flood were upon the earth.
verses.web: After the seven days, the floodwaters came on the earth.

verses.ar: فِي سَنَةِ سِتِّ مِئَةٍ مِنْ حَيَاةِ نُوحٍ، فِي ٱلشَّهْرِ ٱلثَّانِي، فِي ٱلْيَوْمِ ٱلسَّابِعَ عَشَرَ مِنَ ٱلشَّهْرِ فِي ذَلِكَ ٱليَوْمِ، ٱنْفَجَرَتْ كُلُّ يَنَابِيعِ ٱلْغَمْرِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ، وَٱنْفَتَحَتْ طَاقَاتُ ٱلسَّمَاءِ.
verses.kjv: ¶ In the six hundredth year of Noah’s life, in the second month, the seventeenth day of the month, the same day were all the fountains of the great deep broken up, and the windows of heaven were opened.
verses.web: In the six hundredth year of Noah’s life, in the second month, on the seventeenth day of the month, on that day all the fountains of the great deep burst open, and the sky’s windows opened.

verses.ar: وَكَانَ ٱلْمَطَرُ عَلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ أَرْبَعِينَ يَوْمًا وَأَرْبَعِينَ لَيْلَةً.
verses.kjv: And the rain was upon the earth forty days and forty nights.
verses.web: It rained on the earth forty days and forty nights.

verses.ar: فِي ذَلِكَ ٱلْيَوْمِ عَيْنِهِ دَخَلَ نُوحٌ، وَسَامٌ وَحَامٌ وَيَافَثُ بَنُو نُوحٍ، وَٱمْرَأَةُ نُوحٍ، وَثَلَاثُ نِسَاءِ بَنِيهِ مَعَهُمْ إِلَى ٱلْفُلْكِ.
verses.kjv: In the selfsame day entered Noah, and Shem, and Ham, and Japheth, the sons of Noah, and Noah’s wife, and the three wives of his sons with them, into the ark;
verses.web: In the same day Noah, and Shem, Ham, and Japheth—the sons of Noah—and Noah’s wife and the three wives of his sons with them, entered into the ship—

verses.ar: هُمْ وَكُلُّ ٱلْوُحُوشِ كَأَجْنَاسِهَا، وَكُلُّ ٱلْبَهَائِمِ كَأَجْنَاسِهَا، وَكُلُّ ٱلدَّبَّاباتِ ٱلَّتِي تَدِبُّ عَلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ كَأَجْنَاسِهَا، وَكُلُّ ٱلطُّيُورِ كَأَجْنَاسِهَا: كُلُّ عُصْفُورٍ، كُلُّ ذِي جَنَاحٍ.
verses.kjv: They, and every beast after his kind, and all the cattle after their kind, and every creeping thing that creepeth upon the earth after his kind, and every fowl after his kind, every bird of every sort.
verses.web: they, and every animal after its kind, all the livestock after their kind, every creeping thing that creeps on the earth after its kind, and every bird after its kind, every bird of every sort.

verses.ar: وَدَخَلَتْ إِلَى نُوحٍ إِلَى ٱلْفُلْكِ، ٱثْنَيْنِ ٱثْنَيْنِ مِنْ كُلِّ جَسَدٍ فِيهِ رُوحُ حَيَاةٍ.
verses.kjv: And they went in unto Noah into the ark, two and two of all flesh, wherein [is] the breath of life.
verses.web: Pairs from all flesh with the breath of life in them went into the ship to Noah.

verses.ar: وَٱلدَّاخِلَاتُ دَخَلَتْ ذَكَرًا وَأُنْثَى، مِنْ كُلِّ ذِي جَسَدٍ، كَمَا أَمَرَهُ ٱللهُ. وَأَغْلَقَ ٱلرَّبُّ عَلَيْهِ.
verses.kjv: And they that went in, went in male and female of all flesh, as God had commanded him: and the LORD shut him in.
verses.web: Those who went in, went in male and female of all flesh, as God commanded him; then Yahweh shut him in.

verses.ar: وَكَانَ ٱلطُّوفَانُ أَرْبَعِينَ يَوْمًا عَلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ. وَتَكَاثَرَتِ ٱلْمِيَاهُ وَرَفَعَتِ ٱلْفُلْكَ، فَٱرْتَفَعَ عَنِ ٱلْأَرْضِ.
verses.kjv: And the flood was forty days upon the earth; and the waters increased, and bare up the ark, and it was lift up above the earth.
verses.web: The flood was forty days on the earth. The waters increased, and lifted up the ship, and it was lifted up above the earth.

verses.ar: وَتَعَاظَمَتِ ٱلْمِيَاهُ وَتَكَاثَرَتْ جِدًّا عَلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ، فَكَانَ ٱلْفُلْكُ يَسِيرُ عَلَى وَجْهِ ٱلْمِيَاهِ.
verses.kjv: And the waters prevailed, and were increased greatly upon the earth; and the ark went upon the face of the waters.
verses.web: The waters rose, and increased greatly on the earth; and the ship floated on the surface of the waters.

verses.ar: وَتَعَاظَمَتِ ٱلْمِيَاهُ كَثِيرًا جِدًّا عَلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ، فَتَغَطَّتْ جَمِيعُ ٱلْجِبَالِ ٱلشَّامِخَةِ ٱلَّتِي تَحْتَ كُلِّ ٱلسَّمَاءِ.
verses.kjv: And the waters prevailed exceedingly upon the earth; and all the high hills, that [were] under the whole heaven, were covered.
verses.web: The waters rose very high on the earth. All the high mountains that were under the whole sky were covered.

verses.ar: خَمْسَ عَشَرَةَ ذِرَاعًا فِي ٱلِٱرْتِفَاعِ تَعَاظَمَتِ ٱلْمِيَاهُ، فَتَغَطَّتِ ٱلْجِبَالُ.
verses.kjv: Fifteen cubits upward did the waters prevail; and the mountains were covered.
verses.web: The waters rose fifteen cubits higher, and the mountains were covered.

verses.ar: فَمَاتَ كُلُّ ذِي جَسَدٍ كَانَ يَدِبُّ عَلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ مِنَ ٱلطُّيُورِ وَٱلْبَهَائِمِ وَٱلْوُحُوشِ، وَكُلُّ ٱلزَّحَّافَاتِ ٱلَّتِي كَانَتْ تَزْحَفُ عَلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ، وَجَمِيعُ ٱلنَّاسِ.
verses.kjv: And all flesh died that moved upon the earth, both of fowl, and of cattle, and of beast, and of every creeping thing that creepeth upon the earth, and every man:
verses.web: All flesh died that moved on the earth, including birds, livestock, animals, every creeping thing that creeps on the earth, and every man.

verses.ar: كُلُّ مَا فِي أَنْفِهِ نَسَمَةُ رُوحِ حَيَاةٍ مِنْ كُلِّ مَا فِي ٱلْيَابِسَةِ مَاتَ.
verses.kjv: All in whose nostrils [was] the breath of life, of all that [was] in the dry [land], died.
verses.web: All on the dry land, in whose nostrils was the breath of the spirit of life, died.

verses.ar: فَمَحَا ٱللهُ كُلَّ قَائِمٍ كَانَ عَلَى وَجْهِ ٱلْأَرْضِ: ٱلنَّاسَ، وَٱلْبَهَائِمَ، وَٱلدَّبَّابَاتِ، وَطُيُورَ ٱلسَّمَاءِ. فَٱنْمَحَتْ مِنَ ٱلْأَرْضِ. وَتَبَقَّى نُوحٌ وَٱلَّذِينَ مَعَهُ فِي ٱلْفُلْكِ فَقَطْ.
verses.kjv: And every living substance was destroyed which was upon the face of the ground, both man, and cattle, and the creeping things, and the fowl of the heaven; and they were destroyed from the earth: and Noah only remained [alive], and they that [were] with him in the ark.
verses.web: Every living thing was destroyed that was on the surface of the ground, including man, livestock, creeping things, and birds of the sky. They were destroyed from the earth. Only Noah was left, and those who were with him in the ship.

verses.ar: وَتَعَاظَمَتِ ٱلْمِيَاهُ عَلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ مِئَةً وَخَمْسِينَ يَوْمًا.
verses.kjv: And the waters prevailed upon the earth an hundred and fifty days.
verses.web: The waters flooded the earth one hundred fifty days.
